title: Hospital on campus
summary: 24×7 hospital, free consultations and medicines, the IITM HMIS app, ambulance numbers.

posts.md:
The **Institute Hospital** provides **24×7 medical services** for students, faculty, staff, and eligible dependents. Most routine healthcare services are available **free of cost** for students.

## IITM HMIS Mobile App

The **IITM HMIS Mobile App** allows you to access hospital services conveniently without standing in long queues.

## Download the App

- **Android (Google Play):** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cgslhealthapp2&hl=en_IN
- **iOS (App Store):** https://apps.apple.com/in/app/iitm-hmis/id6736517283

## Features

### Easy Login
- Students/Employees: Login using your **LDAP credentials**
- Dependents: Login using **Mobile OTP**

### Quick Access
Quickly access important hospital contact numbers:
- Reception
- Ambulance
- Emergency Numbers

### Book Appointments
- View doctor availability for the next **3 days**.
- **General Doctors:** Book appointments directly through the app.
- **Specialty Doctors:** Appointment requests (through referrals from Institute doctors) require confirmation from the Front Office.

### Digital Prescriptions
- View prescriptions issued during each hospital visit.

### Electronic Medical Records (EMR)
- Access your consultation history and doctors' notes anytime.

## Emergency Ambulance

**Ambulance (Available 24×7):**
- **+91 44 2257 8333**
- **+91 44 2257 8888**

## Consultation & Medicine Charges

- **Doctor consultations are completely free.** There is **no appointment fee**.
- **Medicines prescribed by Institute Hospital doctors are generally provided free of cost.**
- In **rare cases**, some medicines may not be available through the hospital and will need to be purchased separately.

## Hospital Timings

- **Open 24×7**
>  **Tip:** Install the **IITM HMIS App** as soon as possible. It helps you check doctor availability, book appointments, access prescriptions, and view your medical records—all from your phone.
